title: Brooklyn Subway
subtitle: Specially Designed for Avi Yao
heading: UNPACKING & FIRST STARTUP
intro: Read this before plugging in your map. Keep the Quick Start sheet nearby.

steps.title: Unpack with the power disconnected
steps.text: Carefully unwrap the PCB (circuit board) from its bubble wrap. Work slowly to avoid catching the wrapping on any parts. Remove all bags and padding before connecting power. Lift the map by its frame or board edges, never by the screen, knob, wires or small electronic parts. Keep the packaging for future moves.

steps.title: Check the screen and antenna
steps.text: The OLED case is held at the front by magnets. Do not move or remove the round magnet on the back. The antenna exits at the bottom-left and is fastened to the frame; leave it attached. If anything looks loose or damaged, ask Joel before powering up.

steps.title: Choose a safe place
steps.text: Use the map indoors on secure supports, with space around it. Keep it dry and out of direct sunlight, away from heaters, drinks and loose metal objects. Do not rest exposed contacts on metal.

steps.title: Connect the supplied power adapter
steps.text: Use the 5 V, 3 A, center-positive barrel adapter and the map's round power jack. USB-C is for programming and service, not normal power. A greeting, startup sounds and status lights are normal.

steps.title: Connect it to your home Wi-Fi
steps.text: Follow the Quick Start sheet. On your phone, join BrooklynMap-Avi, then open http://192.168.4.1/. Save the administrator password, then home Wi-Fi details. Use a 2.4 GHz network; a shared 2.4/5 GHz name works.

update_title: A FIRMWARE UPDATE MAY RUN AT STARTUP
update_text: After home Wi-Fi connects and the clock synchronizes, the map checks for new firmware. Automatic updates are ON by default unless changed. It may download an update and restart itself. The OLED shows progress and Do not unplug power. Keep power connected until Update complete appears and normal operation returns. Train lights may pause during the update.
after_text: Rejoin home Wi-Fi on your phone, wait 10 seconds, then open the map's address from setup or its Connection screen. Bookmark it. Train lights appear after usable train data arrives.
care: CARE: Unplug barrel power and USB before moving, cleaning or adjusting anything. The POWER button changes the displays; it does not disconnect electrical power.
help: If something seems wrong, contact Joel: goldwein@gmail.com. When the web page works, use Help > Make a support report. Review the email draft before sending.
